poc_updater.title.update: A new Path of Creation version is available
poc_updater.instructions:
Download the update, then exit the game to install it and restart.
Saves, key bindings, and common video settings are preserved.
poc_updater.installing:
The installer is updating the modpack. Please wait.
Restart the game when installation finishes.
poc_updater.downloading:
Downloading Path of Creation v%s…

After downloading, you can exit the game and install the update.
poc_updater.ready:
Path of Creation v%s has been downloaded and verified.

Click "Exit and Install". The installer waits for the game to close, then backs up and replaces files.
Restart the game from your launcher after installation.

Saves, screenshots, key bindings, and extra mods are preserved.
Original files are backed up in local/poc-updater/backups.
poc_updater.failed:
Update incomplete:
%s

Try again or open the release page to install manually.
poc_updater.restart_instructions: Exit this game session, then restart from your launcher.
poc_updater.scroll_hint: Scroll / ↑ ↓ / PageUp PageDown to read the notes
poc_updater.rollback:
Installation failed; recovery of the original files was attempted.
%s

Logs and backups: local/poc-updater
poc_updater.welcome: Welcome to Path of Creation v%s
poc_updater.helper_missing: The installer is missing. Reinstall the updater mod.
poc_updater.helper_stopped: The installer stopped. Check local/poc-updater/install.log and backups before recovering. Do not load a save yet.
poc_updater.no_result: No installation result was found. Check local/poc-updater/install.log.
